limitations: Closed bag query uses body surface plus a fan over ordered material mouth; excludes casing tunnels and cords. Geometric enclosure is approximate for self intersections; no contact or force proof.
Bin cavity follows the actual collider inner lathed y profile and conservative facet inradius. Mouth may overhang rim; bottom >=90%, body >=50% required.
Probe coverage is fixed 63 interior volume samples per bottle, not whole object collision-free containment.

threshold_rationale.bag_in_bin: Bottom >=.90 and body >=.50 inside actual cavity; mouth and casing excluded from placement fractions.
threshold_rationale.material: Body and ordered mouth edge median/rest within .70..1.30 reject collapsed/scaled cloth.
threshold_rationale.cinch: Maximum full 3D pair distance <=.50 of initial; no projection flattening shortcut.
threshold_rationale.clock: Hold durations use simulation time in live runner. Reference has only authored USD timeCodesPerSecond=60, unknown recording clock.

provenance.recording_clock: Unknown; authored USD timecodes do not establish simulation or wall clock
provenance.generator: ipc_drawstring_cinch_geometry.make_bag_mesh(BagGeometryConfig()) topology matches asset; body faces precede casing
provenance.cords: Ignored; animated source and benchmark cord identities differ

reference_calibration.clock: USD authored timecodes / 60 ONLY; source simulation/recording interval unknown
reference_calibration.placement_choice: >=90% bottom and >=50% body; source frame700 bottom1.0/body.7694, final bottom/body1.0. Threshold encodes majority placement and allows mouth above rim; beside/above-bin adversaries are negative.
reference_calibration.not_ground_truth: Reference qualifies geometry after thresholds; no hand assigned completion labels or forced true result.
